svg.text: CAGED SYSTEM — FIVE OPEN SHAPES, ONE NECK
Five open grips — C · A · G · E · D — become every major chord when moved.
Row 1 shows the exact open shapes; the neck below shows them all moved to C, overlapping.

svg.text: ALL FIVE MOVED TO C — OVERLAPPING UP THE NECK
Solid = C major triad (C·E·G) from each CAGED shape moved to C.
C at fret 3 = A-shape (x35533) · C at fret 5 = G-shape (8x5558→C)
C at fret 8 = C- and E-shapes · C at fret 10 = D-shape — bands show each grip’s region.
